title: What Love Owes the Person Who Makes It Possible
subtitle: Food, queer longing, and the quiet labor of making someone else’s world feel easy. A personal reflection on Taiwan Travelogue.
excerpt: In 1938, Aoyama Chizuko arrives in Taiwan as a successful Japanese novelist, pushing back against the pressure to marry and turning down an offer to write propaganda for Japan’s expansion southward. Her humor, appetite, and stubborn streak make freedom feel alive.
